==Skin Trivia==
*The Level 2 Default appearance was based on BelowNatural's wheatfields in the map [[w:c:r2da:Duck's Quest|Ducky's Bootcamp]], from ''Reason 2 Die: Awakening''.
**The original design was taken directly from the model.
*The Level 0 {{Color|Christmas2019|Xmas}} appearance was based on the little Christmas tree ''Charlie Brown'' adopts from the short Christmas animated television special, [[Wikipedia:A Charlie Brown Christmas|A Charlie Brown Christmas]].
*The {{Color|Deluxe|Tycoon}} skin was based on buildings commonly found in Roblox tycoon games.
*Multiple '''Farm''' skins change the sound and the cash pop up which appears when the '''Farm''' generates money. These changes for each skin are:
**The {{Color|Premium|Arcade}} skin changes the font and the cash icon to be pixelated. Changes the sound into an arcade sound.
***The sound actually came from the ''Metal Slug'' video game series.
**The {{Color|Christmas2019|Xmas}} and {{Color|Other|Present}} skins change the sound into a Christmas bells ringing sound.
**The {{Color|Spooky|Graveyard}} skin changes the font, the text into dark yellow, and makes the cash icon darker. Changes the sound into a bones falling sound.
***The sound is actually the same as the death sound of the [[Bones (Trick or Threat Town)|Bones]], [[Hallow Bones]] and [[Hallow Guard (Trick or Threat Town)|Hallow Guard]].
**The {{Color|Ducky|Ducky}} skin changes the sound into a quack sound, but high pitched and repeated three times.
**The {{Color|Deluxe|Crypto}} and {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} skin change the font. The font is different for both skins.
*In the [[Frost Invasion Event]] trailer, a scene shows the '''Farm''' with a ''Vendor'' skin. However, the skin was initially cancelled due to the skin being broken.
**The skin was added over three years later as a [[Codes|code]] skin.
*In the [[Pizza Party]] map, there are arcades scattered around the map that bear a resemblance to the {{Color|Premium|Arcade}} '''Farm'''.
*The car that appears in the Level 4-5 {{Color|Deluxe|Crypto}} skin is based on the [[wp:Tesla Cybertruck|Tesla Cybertruck]].
**The same car being attached to a rocket is most likely a reference to Elon Musk sending his [[wp:Elon Musk's Tesla Roadster|Tesla Roadster]] to space.
*The {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} skin is the first animated '''Farm''' skin.
**Additionally, the {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} is larger than the '''Farm's''' placement footprint. 
*The {{Color|Shamrock|Pot Of Gold}} skin has a unique cash collection effect sending the player green [[w:c:roblox:Ticket|Tix]] instead of cash.
*The {{Color|Other|Present}} skin is currently the only '''Farm''' skin that emits light.
*The {{Color|EventMission|Booth}} skin has a unique cash collecting feature where it sends the player {{Robux|Robux}} instead of cash.
*The {{Color|EventMission|Booth}} skin is the largest skin in the entire game at Level 5.

*The {{Color|Showtime|Cinema}} skin features multiple references to real life creations.
**At Level 1, there is a movie poster for "Exo Strikes Back", a reference to ''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back''.
**At Level 2, there is a movie poster for "Attack of the Ducks; A Duck Who Sold the World", which references multiple things:
***The poster image is a reference to the ''Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain'' game release poster.
***The working poster title, "A Duck Who Sold the World", is a reference to the ''David Bowie'' song ''The Man Who Sold the World'', which was later covered by ''Midge Ure'' and used in ''Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain''.
***The prefixed poster title, "Attack of the Ducks", is a reference to ''Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones''.
****The roman numeral "V" which is behind the prefixed title is another reference to ''Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain''.
**At Level 3, the movie title "A forgotten God's Dream" is a custom title with no outside reference.
